3. The present appeal preferred by the owner of the offending vehicle under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act seeks to assail the award dated 24.12.2022 passed by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal insofar as it grant recovery rights in favour of the respondent no.1.
4.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the learned Tribunal has failed to appreciate that the respondent no.2/driver of the offending vehicle, who is appellant in the connected appeal being MAC.APP. 212/2023 had a valid training certificate to drive a HMV with hazardous goods.

It could,
therefore, would not be said that there was any breach of terms and conditions of the insurance policy.
Learned counsel for the respondent no.1 accepts notice.
